purpose: Planning aid for an agent and reviewer. This is not an executable workflow or comparison plan.

outcome.reported_problem: REPLACE with the user's observation and source
required_behavior: REPLACE with a mandatory observable behavior

integration.base_commit: REPLACE with the full frozen commit ID
editable_paths: REPLACE with the paths needed for this task

targets.id: REPLACE with the actual project target
targets.reason: REPLACE with why the changed behavior needs this target

integration.runtime_and_dependencies: REPLACE with observed versions or an explicit unknown

anchors.poor: REPLACE with an observable poor outcome
anchors.acceptable: REPLACE with an observable acceptable outcome
anchors.excellent: REPLACE with an observable excellent outcome

quality.insufficient_evidence: Do not assign a rating or promote

evaluation.baseline_noise: REPLACE with measured evidence or identify an unknown

search.incumbent: REPLACE with the frozen baseline commit
search.hypothesis: REPLACE with one expected effect and a falsifier
search.candidate_branch: REPLACE with its controller-owned branch identity
search.stop_rule: REPLACE with target, budget, and plateau conditions

feedback.interpretation_and_uncertainty: REPLACE with the inferred quality dimension
feedback.distinguishing_case: REPLACE with a good outcome and a counterexample
feedback.proposed_harness_change: REPLACE with the policy, metric, rubric, skills, or workflow change
feedback.validation_and_rebaseline: REPLACE with calibration evidence and resulting revision

retention.decision_and_evidence: REPLACE with a retained location outside product history
retention.bundle_or_object_retention: REPLACE with a verified source replay reference if required
